name: Jiu Shoubiao - Old Watch
source:
One day, TaiLin received a call from strange woman. The woman told him a secret that the watch he picked up last week was a tool which can help him cross through the time.
When he heard that message he was very exciting. Soon he learnt the winning lottery number and then started time leap.

What he didn't know is that the things waiting in the past wasn't the big prize, it was a lifelong unforgettable memory.

[Edited From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/654260/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
有一天，泰林接到陌生女子的电话。女人告诉他一个秘密，他上周捡到的手表是一个可以帮助他穿越时空的工具。
当他听到这个消息时，他非常兴奋。很快他就知道了中奖号码，然后开始了时空跳跃。

他不知道的是，过去等待的并不是大奖，而是一生难忘的回忆。

[编辑自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/654260/]Steam[/url]]
